profileView.description: A Colibri user as the AppView serves them: identity, resolved profile, and presence.

handle.description: The user's handle, or 'handle.invalid' when it does not resolve.

displayName.description: Resolved display name, falling back to the handle.

avatar.description: URL of the user's avatar, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

banner.description: URL of the user's profile banner, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

isBot.description: Whether the account is labelled as an automated account.

syncBluesky.description: Whether the mirrored profile fields come from app.bsky.actor.profile.

theme.description: Colibri-only profile theming, read from the profile record even when the mirrored fields come from Bluesky.

preferredBadge.description: Label value of the badge the user chose to display.

presence.description: Live presence, when the AppView is tracking any.

voice.description: Where the user is connected for voice, if anywhere.

emoji.description: An emoji shown beside the status.

channel.description: The voice channel the user is connected to.

muted.description: Whether the user's microphone is muted, for any reason.

deafened.description: Whether the user has incoming audio silenced, for any reason.

serverMuted.description: Whether a moderator muted them. When this is true they cannot unmute themselves, and a client must not offer them the control.

serverDeafened.description: Whether a moderator deafened them. When this is true they cannot undeafen themselves.

preferences.description: The authenticated user's own settings, as the AppView currently holds them.

gifFavorites.description: GIFs saved from the picker, stored whole.

subject.description: What is muted. A user or a community is named by DID, a channel by its space.

mutedChannel.description: A muted channel. Muting a channel silences it without leaving the community it belongs to.
